leads.title: Constitution of the State of Pará - 2007 constitutional amendment
leads.documents: Prohibits discrimination based on sexual orientation in Pará
leads.detail: Cited as 'Since 2007, through a constitutional amendment'; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Supreme Federal Court decision (2019)
leads.documents: Banned discrimination based on gender identity
leads.detail: Cited as 'In 2019, discrimination based on gender identity was banned through a decision by the Supreme Federal Court'; no URL visible

leads.title: State Department of Education (SEDUC) Decree no. 016 (2008)
leads.documents: Guarantees right of transgender people to use social name in schools in Pará
leads.detail: Cited as 'In 2008, the State Department of Education (SEDUC) published Decree no. 016'; no URL visible

leads.title: Pará Law No. 7,261 of April 21, 2009
leads.documents: Establishes State Day to Combat Homophobia (Dia Estadual de Combate à Homofobia), signed by Governor Ana Julia Carepa
leads.detail: Law No. 7,261, signed April 21, 2009; no URL visible

leads.title: Pará Decree No. 3,831 of April 8, 2024
leads.documents: Establishes State Council for Sexual Diversity, part of State Secretariat for Racial Equality and Human Rights (SEIRDH), signed by Governor Helder Barbalho
leads.detail: Decree No. 3,831, signed April 8, 2024; no URL visible

leads.title: Pará Law No. 10,570 of June 11, 2024
leads.documents: Establishes State Day of Bisexual Visibility (Dia Estadual da Visibilidade Bissexual), signed by Governor Helder Barbalho
leads.detail: Law No. 10,570, signed June 11, 2024; no URL visible

leads.title: National Council of Justice (CNJ) Provision No. 73
leads.documents: Cited as basis for registry office denial of gender change to third gender option in Ember Alves Oliveira case
leads.detail: Provision No. 73 of the CNJ, 'does not provide for a third gender option'; no URL visible

leads.title: Public Defender's Office of the State of Pará (DPE-PA) action - Ember Alves Oliveira case
leads.documents: First birth certificate with 'X' sex marker in Pará on June 21, 2025; documents official letter to registry in Ananindeua, denials, lawsuit, and human dignity argument
leads.detail: Dated June 21, 2025, Ananindeua registry office; quote on 'source of suffering and anguish'; no URL visible

leads.title: Pará bathroom law of July 14, 2026 + Federal Public Prosecutor's Office veto recommendation + PSOL lawsuit
leads.documents: Authorizes religious temples and schools to restrict bathroom use based on biological sex; Federal Public Prosecutor's Office recommended veto for violating transgender rights and secularism; Socialism and Liberty Party filed lawsuit July 15, 2026
leads.detail: Signed by governor Hana Ghassan (MDB) July 14, 2026; lawsuit announced July 15, 2026; no URL visible
